as_told.title: Jesse Michels' visit to Skinwalker Ranch

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after he visited Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange lights and odd happenings, he had a strange month. He says the things he experienced instilled fear in him, which, as he tells it, suggests that whatever is said to be at the ranch can follow visitors home.
